bounded_findings.2p5cm_WT_FALL: REMOVE_QI is outside the qualified domain for 499 of 512 intervals in both routes; subset-only QI error ratios are not full-history evidence.
bounded_findings.2p5cm_WT_RISE: REMOVE_QI is admissible for all 512 intervals but increases pooled local shape error to about 3.85 times BASE in both routes; REMOVE_QH is outside the qualified domain for 428 intervals.
bounded_findings.5cm_WT_FALL: REMOVE_QI is admissible and reduces pooled local shape error to about 0.5976 of BASE, but REMOVE_GEOMETRY_GI is outside the qualified domain for one interval in each route, so unique-best causal ranking is blocked.
bounded_findings.5cm_WT_RISE: All controls admissible in both routes; REMOVE_QI is unique-best and reduces pooled local shape error to about 0.2972 of BASE.

next_question: Resolve why QI attribution changes with representation width and why counterfactual admissibility fails before preregistering any new terminal-profile/QI reconstruction.
scientific_interpretation: C4E does not support a width-independent claim that QI local bias is the uniquely causal monotone-phase closure defect.
Within this bounded 2.5 cm versus 5 cm laboratory, both causal effect and counterfactual admissibility depend on representation width and history.
The 5 cm RISE result remains valid positive local evidence for QI attribution in that specific case, but it cannot be promoted to a general closure rule.
The 2.5 cm RISE response directly shows that exact removal of the frozen QI contribution can worsen shape fidelity even while remaining physically admissible.
C4B remains authoritative that direct free-running oracle flux substitution is not generally admissible.
No corrected QI closure, direction switch, extra memory state, free propagation, application acceptance or speed claim is authorized.
